summary: DR-ROI-001F Part 1 Platform UI/UX Consistency — Frontend regression pass. Enabled V2 via localStorage dr_v2_optin=1 and visited /daily-report/v2. Verified MASCI navy banner (bg-slate-900 + border-red-700), banner testids (dr-top-banner, dr-top-banner-back, dr-top-banner-actions), EN/ES toggle default EN, ES switch translates header to 'Reporte Diario de Obra' and back, all 10 field sections render in order, autosave status chip present, no PDF text/buttons/testids, no AI branding (GPT/Claude/Gemini/LLM/AI Agent/token cost/confidence score), no PM/Admin/Executive intelligence panels, and V1 /daily/new remains intact with its own navy banner and NO V2 shell leakage. 15/15 substantive assertions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Note (informational only, NOT a bug): body-text substring scan for the token 'model' matches the constraint category label 'Survey / model' — this refers to a survey/BIM model, not an AI model. Not an AI-branding leak. No action required.
V2 shell correctly guards behind isDailyReportV2Enabled(); when disabled it renders dr-v2-disabled preview with the same MASCI navy banner — still compliant with the Invisible Intelligence contract.
test_credentials: Not required — enabled V2 via localStorage.setItem('dr_v2_optin','1'). No login needed to reach /daily-report/v2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V2 route is /daily-report/v2 (NOT /new-daily-report-v2). Flag key is 'dr_v2_optin' (value '1'), not 'dr_v2_enabled'. Language localStorage key is 'dr_v2_field_lang'. V1 route is /daily/new. Both pages share DailyReportTopBanner component but V1 still uses its own inline banner (compliance verified). All 10 sections rendered: Day Setup, MASCI Crews on Site, Equipment on Site, Activity Cards, Delays·Constraints·Extra Work, Tomorrow/Follow-Up, Safety·Quality, Field Photos, Daily Operational Summary, Signature+Submit.
